name: Site Gallery

name: Primary
funding: Arts Council England National Portfolio, National Lottery Heritage Fund, Nottingham City Council; registered charity.

name: John Hansard Gallery
funding: University of Southampton, Arts Council England National Portfolio, Southampton City Council; public university gallery.

name: Bulegoa z/b
funding: Basque Government Cultural Department, Provincial Council of Biscay, City of Bilbao; independent non-profit cultural initiative.

name: Azkuna Zentroa (Alhóndiga Bilbao)
watch: Former municipal wine warehouse transformed by Philippe Starck into a monumental public cultural palace; completely public trust.

name: Centre d'Art la Panera
funding: City Council of Lleida (Ajuntament de Lleida), Generalitat de Catalunya; public contemporary art centre.
watch: Located in a 12th-century medieval grain exchange; public non-commercial contemporary art and artist publishing center.

name: Hangar – Centro de Investigação Artística
funding: Directorate-General for the Arts (DGArtes), Lisbon City Council (Câmara Municipal de Lisboa); non-profit cultural association.

name: Galeria Zé dos Bois (ZDB)
funding: DGArtes (Ministério da Cultura), Lisbon City Council; non-profit cultural association.

name: Fondazione Antonio Ratti
watch: Villa Sucota on Lake Como; CSAV Artists' Research Laboratory directed by international master artists since 1995.

name: Centrale Fies
funding: Autonomous Province of Trento (Provincia Autonoma di Trento), Italian Ministry of Culture, Creative Europe; non-profit foundation.

funding: European Cultural Foundation, Outset Contemporary Art Fund, Greek Ministry of Culture; non-profit foundation.

name: TAVROS
watch: Mid-sized non-profit space in the post-industrial Tavros neighborhood exploring civic responsibility and local community.
